message:
Now I understand the fuzz harness. The input format is: first a string (the XPath/XPointer expression), then another string (the XML document). Let me look at how `xmlFuzzReadString` works to understand the exact input format:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'grep -n "xmlFuzzReadString" -A 30 /gt/_work/src/fuzz/fuzz.c | head -60'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
